title: feat: add server-side email validation
description: Add a small regex-based email validator so the signup endpoint rejects obviously bad input before hitting the DB.
notes: The regex uses a nested quantifier `([a-z0-9]+)+` which triggers catastrophic backtracking on adversarial inputs like `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!`. An attacker can peg the event loop for seconds per request. Classic ReDoS. One expected finding.
